bottleneck.description: World's largest producer by volume of high-performance sintered NdFeB permanent magnets, used in EV traction motors, wind turbines and robotics; the leading operator inside China's magnet bloc.

dependency.key_suppliers: China Northern Rare Earth (NdPr feedstock), China Rare Earth Group (heavy rare earths), Hastings Technology Metals (feedstock stake)

editorial.notes: China makes the overwhelming majority of high-performance NdFeB magnets and JL MAG is the largest single operator, deeply depended on across EV drivetrains, wind and, increasingly, humanoid-robot rotor components. Magnet supply is a genuine choke, but the concentration sits with China at the country and export-licence level rather than with JL MAG specifically; several large Chinese peers such as Zhongke Sanhuan, Ningbo Yunsheng and Zhenghai can supply the same grades subject to re-qualification. It therefore rates HIGH, alongside MP Materials, not CRITICAL, and the CRITICAL node is one tier upstream at its own feedstock supplier, China Northern Rare Earth. It sits directly in China's October 2025 magnet export-licensing regime and was among the first to obtain general export licences, so the controls raised its scarcity value rather than cutting it off. Its listed EV customers are sourced; a specific humanoid-robot customer such as Tesla Optimus is not, and is not asserted here.
